app.title: Drug-sensitivity screen results dashboard: selectivity, model benchmark, similarity, combinations
app.summary: A person opens the dashboard after the analysis pipeline has written its result tables, and picks one of six pages from a sidebar. The overview gives headline counts and a volcano plot of per-compound selectivity against its adjusted significance. A searchable compound table can be narrowed to the significant compounds. The benchmark page sets prediction models side by side with confidence intervals, a permutation null and out-of-fold predictions. Further pages show compound-similarity heatmaps compared by Mantel tests, a ranked list of candidate compound pairs with a rationale and a structural-alert screen, and the significant pathway enrichments. The person ends up with a shortlist of selective compounds and candidate pairs for a follow-up screen.

task.text: Browse the precomputed results of a cell-line drug-sensitivity analysis to see which compounds are selective, how well structure predicts response, and which pairs are worth screening together.

data.text: Result tables written by an analysis pipeline: per-compound response statistics, model benchmark scores with intervals, out-of-fold predictions, pairwise similarity matrices, scored compound pairs and enrichment tests.
data.item: a screened compound with its aggregated response statistics and annotations

stage.text: reviewing the computed results of a drug-sensitivity screen analysis, before choosing compounds and pairs for follow-up screening

mechanism.text: A sidebar radio switches between pages that each read one stage's result files. Each page shows those results as metrics, plotly charts with hover detail, or filterable tables, and a few selectors or a slider pick which slice to show.

field.text: cell-line drug-sensitivity screening and cheminformatic structure-response modelling in cancer pharmacology

workflow.name: review an analysis pipeline's results stage by stage to shortlist candidates

steps.here: Reads the pipeline's results folder: the per-drug summary, benchmark tables, similarity matrices, pair scores, enrichment and run metadata. If nothing has been run, the page stops with an instruction to run the pipeline first.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: Metrics for curves, cell lines, drugs and selective drugs, plus a volcano plot of mean z-score against -log10 q with a dashed FDR line. Hovering a point shows the drug's target and pathway, and the generated results summary sits in an expander.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: The per-drug table, with out-of-fold predictions and novelty scores, can be limited to selective drugs and filtered by text matched against drug name, target or pathway.

Pick a task and a metric to see a grouped bar per model and split strategy, with 95% bootstrap CIs. Below it are a y-scrambling line (real score, permuted mean, empirical p) and an out-of-fold predicted-vs-true scatter for the best grouped-CV model.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Heatmaps of Tanimoto, MCS and GNN-embedding similarity for the candidate drugs, with a table of Mantel tests between the three matrices.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: A slider shows the top N non-excluded drug pairs ranked by a weighted score of target diversity, pathway complementarity, potency and structural novelty, each with a rationale. A structural-alert screen of the top pairs follows.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: Gene-set enrichment of the selective drugs' targets against all screened targets. Shows terms below the FDR cutoff, or the top 30 when none pass.

distinctive: Selectivity is a per-compound z-score against a pan-cancer panel with BH-adjusted significance, drawn as a volcano with an FDR threshold line.
Model scores are always shown with bootstrap intervals over folds and a label-permutation null, under molecule-grouped versus scaffold splits.
Three different notions of structural similarity are set against each other with Mantel tests.
Candidate combinations come with a written rationale and an explicit warning that they are hypotheses, not synergy predictions. Near-duplicate pairs are excluded.

parts.title: Run header and page switcher
parts.summary: Loads every result file, shows which run and data release produced them, and lets the person switch between the six result pages.

parts.title: Overview: counts and selectivity volcano
parts.summary: Gives headline counts and a volcano plot of each compound's mean z-score against its adjusted significance, with hover detail and the generated results summary.

parts.title: Per-drug table with filters
parts.summary: Shows one row per compound, can be limited to selective compounds, and filters rows by text in name, target or pathway.

parts.title: Model benchmark
parts.summary: Compares models for a chosen task and metric with bootstrap CIs, reports the permutation null, and plots out-of-fold predictions for the best model.

parts.title: Similarity heatmaps and Mantel tests
parts.summary: Draws a heatmap for each of three candidate-compound similarity matrices, and tabulates how well each pair of matrices agrees.

parts.title: Ranked combination pairs
parts.summary: Lists the top N scored drug pairs, with score components and a rationale, followed by a structural-alert screen of those pairs.

parts.title: Pathway enrichment
parts.summary: Shows the gene-set terms enriched among the selective compounds' targets, tested against the screened library as background.
